result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, my top recommendation would be **Xero**\. However, the best accounting software depends on whether you're a sole trader, a limited company, or employing staff.

The three I'd shortlist are **Xero, QuickBooks and FreeAgent**\.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent invoicing and expense tracking.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- Good VAT reporting.
- Integrates with lots of other business software.
- Great for growing businesses.

**Best for\:** Limited companies and businesses planning to expand.

Pricing starts around £7–£18/month depending on plan and current pricing. [startups.co.uk](https://startups.co.uk/accounting/best-accounting-software-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.businessaccountingbasics.co.uk](https://www.businessaccountingbasics.co.uk/best-accounting-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[sme-shack.co.uk](https://sme-shack.co.uk/blog/xero-vs-quickbooks-vs-freeagent-which-is-best-for-a-small-uk-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks**

(Best for ease of use)

- Straightforward bookkeeping.
- Excellent mobile app.
- Invoicing and expense management.
- Useful financial reports.
- Good bank reconciliation.

**Best for\:** Sole traders and small businesses wanting simple bookkeeping.

Entry plans start around £10/month. [startups.co.uk](https://startups.co.uk/accounting/best-accounting-software-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[businesstaxation.co.uk](https://businesstaxation.co.uk/compare/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![FreeAgent Review: Features, Pricing, Pros & Cons](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AWrYG5UElICV_2QqNniGBOJg-DuJb7bzMDkMbcm700h1nQnWQTJ-0M80r1lnMU0oD2rFCgi2YvXIZB2Umi8wczyWPQfft3pogJ8F48-Lsaw-bXn26n8ROlYeIROX9k57q9T8hKC5ow8yJaZsxkoZIQjbRlS28cXXnAUhnN7Xx_NmwItPbM1G2HrfhOQcoZLf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreeAgent**

(Best for sole traders)

- Designed around UK tax requirements.
- Self Assessment support.
- Simple income and expense tracking.
- Useful tax forecasting.
- Can be free with qualifying bank accounts.

**Best for\:** Freelancers, contractors and sole traders.

May be free with eligible NatWest, RBS, Ulster Bank or Mettle accounts. [www.businessaccountingbasics.co.uk](https://www.businessaccountingbasics.co.uk/best-accounting-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[sme-shack.co.uk](https://sme-shack.co.uk/blog/xero-vs-quickbooks-vs-freeagent-which-is-best-for-a-small-uk-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Visit FreeAgent](https://www.freeagent.com/)

---

![Sage Group | Company Overview & News](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VFRaM7Mi6n-B6kypx5NEbH6uZ7gv6tyckO56Q4NaZ2LIxfSUsJX7-BpQgCEEs8eZ1yCTkoB51T4Vi6uho9n0Uh-lEm2VXgC1WYeJjEoJCLFmEjEBjRNPbTFFtsAcn4mH6vl8NHzKL61NACimMLcmOKip1T__uRJNPku-4fp2J-5qEQ-yptJXrboOZoUqd8Yu?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Sage**

- Strong accounting and payroll options.
- Good UK tax and VAT functionality.
- Suitable for established businesses.

**Best for\:** Businesses with employees and more traditional accounting requirements.

[Visit Sage](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small UK limited company, I'd start with Xero. For a sole trader, I'd look at FreeAgent first.

One important consideration in the UK is Making Tax Digital (MTD), so check that the particular subscription supports the HMRC submissions you need.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business

There are a few things I'd like to know\:

**1\. What type of business do you run?**

VAT, tax and HMRC compliance
